title: Levelsets
comment: Levelsets — The level set method by [Osher and Sethian, 1988] performs curves and surface evolution by embedding them as the zero level set of a function. Simple and powerful to deal with topological changes (creation of holes, fusion of components). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level-set_method

title: Fast Marching
